data.narrative:
Bohr Systems is a pre-seed stage company in the Defense & Security sector founded by Rohil Gharat (former Antler, Founders Inc., Cisco) and Samarth Kumbla (Columbia CS '27). The valuation universe comprises 2 public comparables (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private peers including Anduril Industries, Helsing, Castelion, Shield AI, and Saronic. However, the peer-median method is not applicable due to insufficient narrow-stage comparables: while 26 same-sector peers exist broadly in Defense & Security, the dataset identified zero same-stage matches, one adjacent-stage match, and zero similar-valuation-tier matches—below the minimum threshold of 3 datapoints required for a reliable median analysis.

No triangulated valuation range can be responsibly established from the provided data. The peer-median approach, typically the most direct method for early-stage companies, fails due to the sparse Defense & Security pre-seed comp set. Other standard methods (comparable transaction multiples, discounted cash flow, venture capital method) lack the necessary financial inputs or transaction data in the dataset provided.

The primary uncertainty is the extreme scarcity of exact-stage comparables in this subsector. A defensible valuation would require either expansion to adjacent defense-tech stages, acquisition of additional financial detail on the five named private peers, or deployment of founder-credential and market-timing anchors not present in the current data. Further data collection is necessary before a quantitative range can be supported.
